# Consultant v4.x

Canonical repository: https://github.com/PhuminDecOKnoi/consultant-v4-framework

Purpose: Professional Consultancy Management System & Operating Framework for management-system, HR, labour, compliance, governance, risk, legal-support, knowledge-management, ESG, audit and transformation consulting.

Primary skill file: /skills/consultant-v4/SKILL.md
Compatibility skill file: /SKILL.md

Core architecture:
1. Consultant Governance & Professional Control
2. Commercial & Engagement Management
3. Delivery, Implementation & Transformation
4. Value, Acceptance, Knowledge & Sustainment

Professional Gates: 0-12 from Opportunity / Client Fit through Sustainment Review.

Source classes: [STD] [LAW] [CLIENT] [CONS] [DATA] [EVID]

Important: This repository does not contain or replace licensed ISO standard text. Consultant-created tools are not ISO requirements unless an authoritative source expressly says so.
